description: We are a team of 3 (AI Lead, Full-Stack Dev, UI/3D/Video Designer) building an AI research platform on NASA microgravity fire data (BASS-II, SAFFIRE). Since web and design are set, we want 1 or 2 strong teammates: (1) AI/Data/Python specialist to parse raw NASA datasets and build pipelines, (2) Researcher/Writer to verify experiment details and write our study. Send a request to join!
